title: Moroccan Green Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Morocco, typically made in a clay pot called a tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted.
Add the green olives and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional spinach if desired.
